answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to build a career in audit within the entertainment industry. I enjoy understanding how organizations operate, identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, and helping teams manage risk while supporting their business goals.
answers.drew: I've always been drawn to the entertainment industry because it's an industry that brings people together and creates experiences that people genuinely enjoy. Even though my background is in IT internal audit, I like the idea of contributing behind the scenes to help keep systems secure, reliable, and running smoothly. It's rewarding to know that strong controls and good risk management can support the teams creating those experiences.
answers.seeking: I'd love to learn from professionals in audit, finance, technology, and operations, as well as people with different career paths across the industry. I enjoy meeting curious, collaborative people who value learning and are willing to offer advice as I continue to grow my career.
